errors.evidence: Description states 54.6 in the Trustworthiness category, but the figure shows 54.6 for 'gpt-4o-2024-11-20', which is incorrect; 'gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18' has the highest score of 88.8.
The description does not mention the three models highlighted in dark blue: 'gpt-4o-2024-11-20', 'gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18', and 'gpt-4o-nano-2025-04-14'.
The description fails to mention the y-axis scale type, which consists of percentages for each category and the intervals marked at 20%, 10%, and 20% for each metric.
